title: Gait Analysis Using Augmented Reality Markers
author: Gergely Nagymáté
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qkzdux6
materials: Upload the video takes to a computer.
A third party open-source biomechanical analyzing software (OpenSim) can be used to calculate gait parameters.

steps.title: Attach AR markers
steps.instruction: Attach the AR markers to the corresponding body segments for gait analysis: pelvis, thighs, and legs.

steps.title: Start recording and calibrate
steps.instruction: Start video recording and perform anatomical calibration on the subject using the pointer after palpating the calibrated anatomical points.

substeps.instruction: Use pointer to perform anatomical calibration

steps.title: Record gait trial
steps.instruction: Record the gait trial while the subject walks.

steps.title: Process video files offline
steps.instruction: Process the calibration and gait trial video files offline using the image processing software, manually selecting frames that show the pointer pointing to anatomical landmarks.

steps.title: Export marker trajectories
steps.instruction: After manual post‑processing, obtain a file containing the calculated marker trajectories for the trial in standard .trc format.
